records.jp: あ、いたっ。<CR>梨佳と……三井さん？
records.en_original: Oh, there she is. <CR>Rika and...Mitsui, was it?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, there she is.<CR>Rika and...Mitsui, was it?
records.en: Oh, there they are.<CR>Rika and...Mitsui-san?

records.jp: なんだか様子がおかしいね……
records.en_original: It looks like there's something wrong...
records.en_auxiliary: It looks like there's something wrong...
records.en: It looks like there's something wrong...

records.jp: 嘘！　ミキ先輩が犯人なわけないっ！
records.en_original: NO! Miki can't be the culprit!
records.en_auxiliary: NO! Miki can't be the culprit!
records.en: No! There's no way Miki-senpai is the culprit!

records.jp: あたしだってまだ信じられないって。<CR>でも、実際そうなんだから仕方ないじゃん
records.en_original: I don't like it any more than you do, but those are the facts...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't like it any more than you do, but those are the facts...
records.en: I still can't believe it either.<CR>But if it's true, there's nothing we can do.

records.jp: 二人とも、犯人のこともう知ってるみたいだね
records.en_original: Looks like they've heard the news.
records.en_auxiliary: Looks like they've heard the news.
records.en: Looks like they've heard the news.

records.jp: それにしても、どうしてあんなに怒ってるんだろう？
records.en_original: But why would Rika be so angry about it?
records.en_auxiliary: But why would Rika be so angry about it?
records.en: But why are they so angry?

records.jp: ……あっ
records.en_original: ...Huh.

records.jp: （会いたいでしょ、ミキ先輩）
records.en_original: (Don't you want to see Miki again?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Don't you want to see Miki again?)
records.en: (Don't you want to see Miki-senpai again?)

records.jp: （うん、まあ）
records.en_original: (Well, sure.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Well, sure.)
records.en: (Well, sure.)

records.jp: （私たちが陸上を始めたきっかけだもんね！<CR>最近、また１００メートルの記録を更新したんだよ！）
records.en_original: (Of course you do, she's the reason we started track in the first place! Just improved her time on the 100-meter, too!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Of course you do, she's the reason we started track in the first place! She just improved her time on the 100-meter, too!)
records.en: (She's the reason we started track, after all!<CR>She broke her 100-meter record again recently!)

records.jp: （亜子から聞いた犯人の名前、<CR>梨佳たちの憧れの先輩だった……）
records.en_original: (Wait, the girl Ako told me is the culprit is...the girl that both of them admire...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Wait, the girl Ako told us who is the culprit...is the same girl both of them admire.)
records.en: (The culprit Ako told us about<CR>was the senpai Rika and Kaori admired...)

records.jp: ヒナちゃん？
records.en_original: Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: Hina?
records.en: Hina-chan?

records.jp: ていうか、こんな時までゲームしないでよ！
records.en_original: How can you play your games at a time like this?
records.en_auxiliary: How can you play your games at a time like this?
records.en: How can you play your games at a time like this?

records.jp: 香織は悲しくないの！？
records.en_original: Kaori, aren't you sad about this!?
records.en_auxiliary: Kaori, aren't you sad about this?!
records.en: Kaori, aren't you sad about this!?

records.jp: 香織！
records.en_original: KAORI!
records.en_auxiliary: KAORI!
records.en: KAORI!

records.jp: ……悲しい、に決まってんじゃん
records.en_original: ...Of course I'm sad.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Of course I'm sad.
records.en: ...Of course I'm sad.

records.jp: 先輩のこと、すげー尊敬してたし、<CR>目標にもしてた
records.en_original: I admired Miki more than anyone else. I wanted to be just like her.
records.en_auxiliary: I admired Miki more than anyone else. I wanted to be just like her.
records.en: I really respected Miki-senpai,<CR>and she was my role model.

records.jp: それが裏切られたっていうか、<CR>話聞いた時、マジで幻滅したし
records.en_original: When I first heard she was behind this, I felt betrayed...now I just feel disillusioned.
records.en_auxiliary: When I first heard she was behind this, I felt betrayed...now I just feel disillusioned.
records.en: I felt betrayed.<CR>When I heard, I was seriously disillusioned.

records.jp: だったら！
records.en_original: And!?
records.en_auxiliary: So then—
records.en: Then...!

records.jp: だったら何だっての！？
records.en_original: And, WHAT!?
records.en_auxiliary: So then, WHAT?!
records.en: Then what!?

records.jp: だからって、どうもできないでしょ！？<CR>そんな風に怒鳴ったら、どうにかなるわけ！？
records.en_original: What do you think I can do about all this!? Do you think screaming at me will solve anything!?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you think I can do about all this?! Do you think screaming at me will solve anything?!
records.en: What do you think I can do about it!?<CR>Do you think yelling at me will change anything!?

records.jp: 先輩が犯人だったって事実が、なくなるわけじゃないじゃん！？
records.en_original: Nothing can change what Miki's done!
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing can change what Miki's done!
records.en: That doesn't erase the fact that Miki-senpai was the culprit!

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: That's...
records.en_auxiliary: That's...
records.en: That's...

records.jp: ヒナちゃん……
records.en_original: Hey, Hina...
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Hina...
records.en: Hina-chan...

records.jp: ケンカ……を止めないとだよね！
records.en_original: We need to put an end to this fight!
records.en_auxiliary: We need to put an end to this fight!
records.en: We have to stop them from fighting...right?

records.jp: 二人とも、落ち着いて！
records.en_original: Calm down, both of you!
records.en_auxiliary: Calm down, both of you!
records.en: Calm down, both of you!

records.en_original: Who the--?
records.en_auxiliary: Who the—?
records.en: ...Who are you?

records.jp: ……日菜子ちゃん
records.en_original: Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako...
records.en: ...Hinako-chan.

records.jp: 先輩のこと、ショックなのはわかる。<CR>でも、だからって二人がケンカするのは違うと思う……！
records.en_original: I understand that what Miki did is shocking, but that doesn't mean you two should fight about it!
records.en_auxiliary: I understand that what Miki did is shocking, but that doesn't mean you two should fight about it!
records.en: I understand how shocked you are by what happened with Miki-senpai.<CR>But I don't think you two should be fighting because of it...!

records.jp: 何が違うっていうのさ。<CR>あんたは関係ないんだから、放っておいてくれない？
records.en_original: Why do you think you can tell US what to do? You have nothing to do with this!
records.en_auxiliary: Why do you think you can tell us what to do? You have nothing to do with this!
records.en: What do you mean it's wrong?<CR>This has nothing to do with you, so could you stay out of it?

records.jp: そうだよ日菜子ちゃん！<CR>悪いけど……これは、私たちの問題なの！
records.en_original: She's right, Hinako! I'm sorry, but this is between us!
records.en_auxiliary: She's right, Hinako! I'm sorry, but this is between us!
records.en: That's right, Hinako-chan!<CR>Sorry, but...this is our problem!

records.jp: えっ！？
records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.jp: ミキ先輩に憧れて、陸上部に入って、<CR>今日まで頑張ってきたのに……
records.en_original: I've admired Miki. I joined track and worked so hard to be just like her...
records.en_auxiliary: I've admired Miki. I joined track and worked so hard to be just like her...
records.en: I admired Miki-senpai, joined the track team,<CR>and worked hard all this time...

records.jp: ぼ、暴走が……
records.en_original: She's gong rampant...
records.en_auxiliary: She's going rampant...
records.en: S-She's going rampant...

records.jp: ……ホント、許せない。<CR>あたしら、裏切られたんだよ……
records.en_original: ...I'll never forgive her. She betrayed us...
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'll never forgive her. She betrayed us...
records.en: ...I really can't forgive her.<CR>She betrayed us...

records.jp: こっちも！？
records.en_original: Her too!?
records.en_auxiliary: Her too?!
records.en: Kaori too!?

records.jp: まさか二人同時だなんて……。<CR>マズイね、これは
records.en_original: I can't believe it, they've both gone rampant at the same time... Ooh boy, this isn't good.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't believe it, they've both gone rampant at the same time... Ooh boy, this isn't good.
records.en: Both at the same time...?<CR>This is bad.

records.jp: ……順番に入るしかない
records.en_original: So, what, will we have to go into one, then the other?
records.en_auxiliary: So, what, will we have to go into one, then the other?
records.en: ...We'll have to enter one, then the other.

records.jp: それしかなさそうね
records.en_original: Seems like that might be our only option.
records.en_auxiliary: Seems like that might be our only option.
records.en: That seems to be our only option.

records.jp: でも、コモンはみんなで共有している<CR>集合的無意識の世界
records.en_original: Still, as an embodiment of the collective unconscious, the Common is a shared world.
records.en_auxiliary: Still, as an embodiment of the collective unconscious, the Common is a shared world.
records.en: But the Common is a world of the collective unconscious<CR>shared by everyone.

records.jp: 同じ感情が暴走しているのなら、<CR>二人のフラグメントも、近い距離にあるかも
records.en_original: If they have similar emotions going rampant, their fragments might be near to each other.
records.en_auxiliary: If they have similar emotions going rampant, their Fragments might be close to each other.
records.en: If the same emotion is going rampant,<CR>their Fragments might be close to each other.

records.jp: わかった。行こう！
records.en_original: Let's hope so. Come on!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's hope so. Come on!
records.en: Got it. Let's go!

records.jp: （二人とも、絶対に助けてみせる！）
records.en_original: (I'll save you two, I promise!)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'll save you two, I promise!)
records.en: (I'll save you two, I promise!)
